purpose: A list of frames no tilt could reconcile, gathered for plan 5 -- a SYMPTOM, not a per-frame lens measurement. This plan's pre-flight already showed that fitting a lens (fov) alongside pitch is degenerate on real frames (see sensitivityDegPerDegRef), so no single conversion coefficient is offered here and none should be inferred from this file. Nobody acts on this in plan 4e -- meta.photoFovLong is not edited by either task 3 or task 4.

willNotConvergeCount.note: MEASURED, not assumed: zero spots in either apartment's derivation carry the outcome will-not-converge (see each apartment's own -derivation.json outcomeTally.willNotConverge, both []). Every spot with an identifiable landmark converged to either tilt-confirmed or level-confirmed once swept. The `spots` array below is therefore built from the outcome no-usable-landmark instead -- a step-1 finding made BEFORE any tilt was tried ('there was nothing in both frames to point a tilt at'), which is what this plan actually has to offer as lens-adjacent evidence. Only the subset whose own written reason is consistent with an FOV/scale symptom (a real but too-weak or absent gradient, not a different object or missing furniture asset) is included; the excluded furniture/content-mismatch spots are listed in `excludedNotLensRelated` for completeness.

documentedRef: tour/apartments/kings-court.json meta.photoFovLong and tour/apartments/serenity.json meta.photoFovLong both ship 120
priorMeasurementsRef: tour/apartments/kings-court.json photoSpots poseNotes: 2.webp measures the photograph at ~58deg horizontal against the documented 120, and 10.webp measures ~57deg vertical-equivalent against the documented 120 -- two independent methods, both well under half the documented value.
sensitivityDegPerDegRef: docs/superpowers/metrics/b4e-preflight-method-rejection.json fovCoupling.dPitchPerDegFov -- how much a fitted pitch shifts per degree of assumed vfov, measured across both apartments' spots before this plan ran a single browser capture. The pre-flight's own reading: 'too inconsistent to hand plan 5 a conversion coefficient. A tilt fitted under an assumed vfov is not convertible to another vfov by a shared constant.'

excludedNotLensRelated.note: Also outcome no-usable-landmark, but excluded from `spots` above because their own written reason names a furniture-model, layout, or missing-asset mismatch instead -- a different defect class, most of it already routed to plan 5 through each spot's own poseNote. Listed for completeness, not as lens evidence.
